confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026 peak season, not based on live listings. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, and drinks are least certain. Turkish lira prices move quickly, so USD values may drift. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge of those prices is weak (cocktail about 1.75x beer, wine glass about 1.5x beer). FX is the RBA observation for 15 October 2026; a 16 October figure was not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a Mediterranean and Aegean resort town on the Turkish Riviera, priced like southern European coastal resorts (e.g., Fethiye and Bodrum in Turkey, and Greek or Croatian coastal resorts) with lower restaurant prices than Western Europe. Accommodation assumes July peak-season rates, including taxes and fees.
